editionLabel: Thames & Kosmos original English edition, item 696116
firstPlayerRule: The youngest player begins. Play then proceeds clockwise.
houseFallback: If two or more players are equally youngest, choose among them at random. This is a house-rule suggestion, not a publisher instruction.
clarifications: This answer covers the manual's standard game for two to four players; the solitaire and partnership variants are separate.
Thames & Kosmos lists a separate second-edition manual for the same item number. This answer cites the original manual only.

internalEvidence: Thames & Kosmos' official manual archive explicitly separates Ingenious (original) from Ingenious (2nd Edition), both item 696116, and links the original English PDF. The publisher-hosted original PDF is 1,497,125 bytes, two pages, SHA-256 69a84dd33991727ab241a6c5d660c68a97be71ea1564cfb5baf069b7a8449e69. Codex visually inspected PDF page 1 under Standard Game for 2–4 Players > Play: the youngest begins and play proceeds clockwise. The same manual contains solitaire and partnership sections; neither is transferred here. Sealed source packet: artifacts/pending-rules-followup-sep28i/REVIEW.md, seal e671a00bf10af7cf17696ee421a1a3c6d174fdd869d437c73ffae584f59858b1. Exact active BGG 9674 / Wikidata Q1307125 identity had no approved rule at 6146f5a or 089c464. Portable pool enrollment remains separate.
uncertainty: The manual does not state an official tie-break when two people are equally youngest.
No starting rule is inferred for the second edition, solitaire play, or partnership variant.
